programs.title: Bamazon
programs.desc: Darryl Haynes and John Wilson return to base camp to deliver bad news. Tim Evans turns to second-string heavy equipment operator Clate McDaniel to attempt a mission again.

programs.title: Mark Berg's Fishing Addiction
programs.desc: Fishing expert Mark Berg visits some of the best fishing destinations around. Chasing a wide variety of fish, Mark is always hoping to capture a new species or develop a new technique.

programs.title: Merv Hughes Fishing
programs.desc: Merv Hughes Fishing is a light hearted fishing show with some ripping catches, a few yarns (mostly true), mateship and of course a splash of comedy thrown in.

programs.title: Creek To Coast
programs.desc: Olivia hangs out with some budding fishos. Gary is talking all things electric motors. Liz is cooking up a camp favourite. Scott is with the Gold Coast SUNS catching a few flathead.

programs.title: Deadliest Roads
programs.desc: Trucker Hugh Rowland takes on an old donkey trail with some dynamite during his nearly impossible climb into the Andes.

programs.title: Swamp People: Serpent Invasion
programs.desc: Troy and Pickle face a familiar foe, while Bill and Tes defend a friend's camp from a slithering invasion. Zak and Aaron's hunt leaves a bad taste in their mouths, and Dusty Crum has a plan to work smarter not harder.
